query: What are the top quality and creative trends in Social Sciences related to interdisciplinary pilot studies, robust methodologies, synthetic data governance, spatial diagnostics, and stakeholder engagement?

response.query: What are the top quality and creative trends in Social Sciences related to interdisciplinary pilot studies, robust methodologies, synthetic data governance, spatial diagnostics, and stakeholder engagement?
response.answer: Interdisciplinary pilot studies emphasize robust methodologies and stakeholder engagement. Synthetic data governance focuses on ethical data use and compliance. Spatial diagnostics leverage big data for policy insights.

results.content: ### [Freud and the algorithm: neuropsychoanalysis as a framework to understand artificial general intelligence](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41599-021-00812-y?fromPaywallRec=false) Artificial general intelligence (AGI) aims to replicate human cognitive capabilities across domains, setting the stage for transformative societal and economic impacts, particularly in areas involving human decision-making and adaptive reasoning[1](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-92190-7#ref-CR1 "Fjelland, R. 7(1), 1–9 (2020)."),[2](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-92190-7#ref-CR2 "Yampolskiy, R. The ultimate leap to artificial superintelligence (ASI) involves machines that surpass human intelligence, presenting unparalleled opportunities for innovation alongside significant ethical and existential challenges[4](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-92190-7#ref-CR4 "Barrett, A. 29(2), 397–414 (2017)."),[5](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-92190-7#ref-CR5 "Gill, K. AI Soc. 31, 137–143 (2016)."),[6](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-92190-7#ref-CR6 "Pueyo, S. 7(01), 63–72 (2020)."),[9](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-92190-7#ref-CR9 "Yampolskiy, R.
